subject: 9mmhandgun
label: 9mmhandgun, in the place of the game's models/v_9mmhandgun.mdl, models/p_9mmhandgun.mdl, models/w_9mmhandgun.mdl

measured.lineup: ours is one of A to D in lineup.png beside models/w_grenade.mdl, models/w_satchel.mdl, models/w_357.mdl: the judge does not know which

M1.reason: Top and below views give a pistol-like L (long grey slide, black arm), but the front, back, left and right views are a thin flat bar about 1.4 thick with no grip hanging below the slide. A standing 9mm pistol's outline is not there in the side views.

M2.reason: The brief gives no length (sizeAsked null, sizeOff null), so the harness had no size to hold it to. Nothing confirms the 8.4 x 1.4 x 7.6 units as a pistol's scale, and the flat side views do not show a pistol's height.

M3.reason: The grey slide and a black frame block are there. The trigger guard, trigger and magazine are not visible in any view, and a small hex fitting on the back view is unexplained. Small parts are missing, so M3 is capped at 1.

M4.reason: Light grey metal on the slide and near-black on the frame match the brief's black and grey polymer and steel. Nothing in the colour or material reads wrong.

M5.reason: The brief asks for no markings. The fine serrations on the grey slide and the small pieces at the ends add nothing wrong.

M6.reason: In the line-up (A) it is a flat grey and black block with no recognisable pistol form, and it sits clearly apart from the grenade, the .357 and the satchel. A player would not take it for one of the game's.

M7.reason: The model lies flat, with its thin axis vertical in the front and side views, rather than standing upright as a pistol does. The front is not clearly identifiable.

M8.reason: checkErrors is empty. At 108 triangles it is well under twice the Half-Life median of 142 (284) and under the three-quarter mark of 187.

W1.reason: In first-person the gun sits roughly where the game's sits, over the right hand's position. It reads as a block resting on the hand rather than gripped, and in the attack frames 0 and 8 it looks shrunken and shifted. It does not clearly leave the hand, but the way round and the hold are not convincing.
